why: 结论 43: a background thread is part of the contract, and what makes it usable is that its events can be attributed to the card they belong to — by the `thread_label` the agent gave the sub-thread, which every harness must carry through unchanged. A subagent that starts and dies having called nothing is invisible unless the start is an event of its own — which is exactly the case a reader needs told. Its closing words are asserted too: the spawner's context is where they otherwise stay, so a harness that reports the stop but loses the text has not said the same thing as one that reports both, and a cell that only had to agree on the id could differ there in silence.
